about.title: More Than Five Decades of Craftsmanship
about.lead: Established by Fayez Wahbeh in 1970, Fayiz Wahbeh focuses on premium brick and clay products for architects, builders, residential and commercial projects, and specialised applications.
about.text: From traditional clay craftsmanship to modern architectural applications, the company continues to build on experience passed across generations — refining materials that are made to be trusted, and built to endure.
about.imageAlt: A craftsman in a Fayiz Wahbeh apron measuring a clay brick with a steel ruler
about.detailAlt: Stone villa entrance under a terracotta tile roof

fireBricks.name: Fire Bricks
fireBricks.text: Dense, heat-resistant bricks for furnaces, ovens, chimneys and industrial settings that demand durability at high temperatures.

clayTiles.name: Portuguese Lógica
clayTiles.text: Portuguese Lógica clay tiles that bring warmth, weather resistance and lasting architectural character to pitched roofs.
clayTiles.ideal: Suited to pitched roofs, villas and heritage-inspired architecture.

architecturalBricks.name: Architectural Bricks
architecturalBricks.text: Facing and decorative bricks for expressive masonry — from contemporary facades to timeless garden walls.
